% Pattern: number/paragraph. The paper numbers its paragraphs, with
% \setcounter{secnumdepth}{4} and a command \newpar for \paragraph, and opens
% each paragraph with \newpar{}. A statement environment without a counter
% right after \newpar{} prints the number of the paragraph, 1.0.2; one after
% text in the paragraph prints no number. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want proposition-1 statement/proposition 1.0.2
% want proposition-2 statement/proposition -
\documentclass{amsart}
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{4}
\renewcommand{\theparagraph}{\arabic{section}.\arabic{subsection}.\arabic{paragraph}}
\newcommand{\newpar}{\paragraph}
\newenvironment{Proposition}{\smallskip\noindent{\sc Proposition.}}{\bigskip}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\newpar{} Some text in the first paragraph.

\newpar{}
\begin{Proposition} Every compact space is bounded. \end{Proposition}

\newpar{} More text in the third paragraph.
\begin{Proposition} Every finite space is compact. \end{Proposition}
\end{document}
